name: African proverb
description: Today, it remains a timeless metaphor for collateral damage in disputes, often invoked in discussions of war, politics, or social divisions.
quote: “When two elephants fight, it is the grass that gets hurt.”

name: Opaline Pinot Noir Brut Rosé
description: Sourced from the south of France, this brut rosé highlights the versatility and elegance of the Pinot Noir grape.
specs: An elegant French sparkling wine presented in a faceted bottle, featuring delicate bubbles and notes of red berries.

name: Emmolo Sauvignon Blanc 2023
description: Created by the Wagner family, utilizing grapes from family-owned vineyards to produce a wine that is distinctively fresh. The result is a crisp and bright white wine with flavors of melon and citrus, sourced from Napa Valley.

name: Perfekt Small Batch
description:
A modern, minimalist wine focused on purity, distinct varietal character, and clean finishing notes.

 Produced in limited quantities to ensure the highest quality control and expression of the vineyard's terroir.

name: Bumbu XO Handcrafted Rum
description:
A smooth, rich rum aged up to 18 years in bourbon barrels and finished in white oak sherry casks.
 
Distilled in Panama, Bumbu XO pays homage to the 16th-century sailors who blended Caribbean fruits and spices into their rum.

name: Dictador 12 Year Rum
description:
A Colombian rum made via fermentation of virgin sugar cane honey and aged using the solera system.

Established in 1913 in Cartagena de Indias, Dictador combines Colombian traditions with European design and Japanese bottle aesthetics.

name: Grey Goose Vodka
description:
A premium French vodka made from the finest winter wheat and Gensac spring water.

Distilled in France using a field-to-bottle process designed to express the true character of the ingredients.

name: Tekirdağ Rakısı Trakya Serisi
description:
A premium Turkish Raki distilled from fresh grapes of the Thrace region.

 History: "Produced using the traditional copper alembic distillation method, utilizing high-quality aniseed and the finest grapes from Western Turkey."

name: Bacardi Dragonberry
description:
A bold fusion of strawberry and crisp dragon fruit flavor infused into white rum.
 
History: Created by the masters of rum blending, this spirit combines the sweet, juicy taste of strawberries with the exotic zest of dragon fruit.

name: Hennessy Paradis
description:
A sensual and voluptuous cognac, created from a blend of over 100 rare eaux-de-vie aged for decades.
 History: Created in 1979 by Maurice Fillioux, this cognac is defined by its graceful, silky character and aromatic richness.
        founder:

name: The Dalmore 40 Year Old
description:
An ultra-rare Highland Single Malt, matured in American white oak and Gonzalez Byass Matusalem oloroso sherry butts.

 History: A pinnacle of whisky making, this bottle represents four decades of careful maturation in the Scottish Highlands.

name: The Obsidian Strand
description:
Triple-layer black cylindrical beads. Dark, sleek, and mysterious.

History: Black beads traditionally signify wisdom and age. We polished these to a mirror finish to reflect the modern leader's clarity of thought.

name: The Royal Peach Coral
description:
Authentic peach coral set with a centerpiece gemstone pendant.

History: Sourced from the deep seas, peach coral is known as the 'stone of diplomacy.' A perfect accessory for high-stakes negotiations.

name: The Gilded Sunset
description:
Vibrant orange coral interlaced with intricate gold filigree spacers.

 History: Orange represents joy and creativity; gold represents wealth. Together, they form the 'Prosperity Set,' worn during celebrations of success.

name: The Amber Legacy
description:
Long strands of rectangular amber and brown agate beads.

 History: Earthy tones that ground the wearer. These beads are designed for the elder statesman who remains connected to his roots while reaching for the sky.

name: The Bronze Armor
description:
Metallic bronze cylindrical beads with a heavy, industrial luxury weight.

 History: Unlike traditional coral, these metallic beads are forged. They represent the 'Iron Will' of the wearer—unbreakable and shining under pressure.

name: The Dual Heritage Bangle
description:
A wrist set featuring red coral and white ivory-toned beads.

 History: Red for vitality, White for peace. This combination balances the fire of ambition with the calmness of strategy.

name: The Verdant Houndstooth
description:
A double-breasted masterpiece in forest green check, paired with pristine ivory trousers.

 History: Inspired by the British countryside but tailored for the tenacious modern leader. The houndstooth pattern signifies a complex mind that finds order in chaos.

name: The Executive Pinstripe
description:
A three-piece charcoal power suit with razor-sharp pinstripes.

History: The pinstripe was originally the uniform of the bank; we reclaimed it as the armor of the self-made tycoon. Precision-cut to impose authority without saying a word.

name: The Artiste Senator
description:
Navy blue traditional wear featuring a hand-painted avant-garde chest patch.

 History: A fusion of traditional silhouette and modern art. The patch represents the 'Canvas of Life'—reminding the wearer that they are the artist of their own destiny.

name: The Gilded Noir
description:
Deepest black evening wear accented by a striking gold surrealist lapel brooch.

History: Designed for the gala, this piece is about the 'Golden Silence.' The bespoke gold face brooch signifies that true power watches and listens more than it speaks.

name: The Diplomat Navy
description:
Single-breasted classic navy pinstripe. The definition of reliability.

History: Woven from 120s Italian wool, this suit is the backbone of the tenacious man's wardrobe. It is designed to look as sharp at 8 PM as it did at 8 AM.

name: The Sovereign Drape
description:
A minimalist, structural navy kaftan with a unique cape-like silhouette.

History: Drawing inspiration from royal robes, this piece removes all unnecessary noise. It focuses purely on structure and drape, allowing the wearer's presence to fill the room.

name: The Crimson Heritage
description:
Rich burgundy Senator wear with geometric embroidery and matching cap.

History: The deep red signifies the blood and sweat of the hustle. The geometric embroidery is a nod to ancient architectural stability. Wear this to celebrate a victory.

name: The Rose Quartz Statement
description:
A daring double-breasted suit in soft dusty pink. For the man who fears nothing.",

History: It takes true tenacity to wear pink with power. This suit challenges traditional masculinity, proving that strength can exist in softness and unparalleled style.

name: The Ivory & Mocha Duo
description:
Cream double-breasted jacket paired with rich chocolate trousers.

History: A masterclass in contrast. Reminiscent of Italian summers, this combination is for the leisure class—the man who has worked hard enough to finally enjoy the sun.

name: The Slate Monolith Agbada
description: A minimalist slate-grey Agbada featuring intricate geometric embroidery.

name: The Emerald Sovereign
description: Deep forest green ensemble with vertical embroidery and matching cap.

name: The Olive Heritage Set
description: Textured olive green Aso-Oke fabric accessorized with green glass beads.

name: Royal Coral Cuff
description: Stacked natural coral beads worn on the wrist and neck. A stunning and royal jewelry that speaks royalty.

name: The Fusion Wrist"
description: Red coral beads paired with a gold diamond-encrusted timepiece.

name: Ancestral Coral Strands
description: Long, cylindrical coral beads draped over white textured fabric. This is a clear visual of the traditional royal attire of the reps of the palace of the Oba of Benin

name: The Executive Pinstripe
description: Beige double-breasted pinstripe suit with peaked lapels-Giving a smooth clean look for men.

name: Royal Salute 21 (The Sapphire)
description:
21-Year-Old Blended Scotch Whisky in a porcelain flagon.

History: Originally created to mark the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II. This spirit is aged for a minimum of 21 years, offering a velvet finish fit for those who are building their own dynasties

name: Diplomático Selección de Familia
description:
Premium Venezuelan dark rum paired with a hand-rolled cigar.

History: The 'Selection of the Family' is not for rushing. It is a slow-sipping rum with complex notes of vanilla and oak, best enjoyed in the quiet hours after the deal is closed.

name: Azure Blue Couple's Agbada
description: Stunning azure blue fabric with laser-cut detailing. A fusion of tradition and modern fashion.

name: Royal Purple Ceremonial Set
description: Deep royal purple agbada with heavy embroidery, paired perfectly for a coordinated couple's look.

name: Bridal White Traditional Set
description: The ultimate couple's statement. Matching pure white traditional attire with intricate fringe detailing.

name: Chocolate Brown Double-Breasted
description: A rich chocolate brown suit with a modern double-breasted cut. Timeless elegance for formal occasions.

name: Burnt Orange Royal Agbada
description: Vibrant and majestic. This burnt orange set features elaborate embroidery, perfect for making a grand entrance.

name: Edo Royal Bridal Bead Set
description: A complete, breathtaking set of authentic coral beads for the Edo bride who demands royalty.

name: Traditional Attire
description: As seen on icons. A pristine white textured agbada that signifies purity, wealth, and high status. Featuring Nigerian music star Davido.
